notes:
### 1. Product Overview
LiveAgent is an all-in-one customer support and helpdesk platform that unifies multiple communication channels—including email ticketing, live chat, a built-in voice call center, and social media helpdesk—into a single centralized agent dashboard.
* **Source URL:** `https://support.liveagent.com/741982-API-key`
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"liveagent is an integrated customer support software , ticketing system , live chat , social helpdesk and voice helpdesk ."`

### 2. Authentication Methods & Multi-Tenant Integration
LiveAgent provides two main versions of its public API (v1 and v3), both of which rely on static API keys.
* **API v3 Authentication:** Uses an API key passed via the request headers.
  * **Source URL:** `https://support.liveagent.com/741982-API-key`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"api v3 use your api key has to be set in header of your requests: curl --location --request get 'https://your.ladesk.com/api/v3/tickets' \ --header 'apikey: 0865evv883j6auflvlt7zrwgqn32qo74'"`
* **API v1 Authentication:** Uses an API key passed as a query parameter.
  * **Source URL:** `https://support.liveagent.com/840770-Complete-API-reference`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"curl_setopt ( $ch , curlopt_url , "http :// example . com / api / agents /[ agentidentifier ]? &apikey = value" ) ;"`

* **Primary Auth for Multi-Tenant Integration:** `api_key`
LiveAgent does not provide a public OAuth2 application registration system for third-party multi-tenant integration platforms to dynamically authenticate end-users via a centralized marketplace app. Instead, multi-tenant platforms must prompt each customer to manually generate and provide their own account-specific API key.

### 3. Credential Acquisition & Cost
* **Access Level:** `self_serve_trial`
* **Cost & Acquisition:** Anyone can sign up for a 30-day free trial without a credit card to obtain working API credentials. After the trial expires, a paid subscription is required (starting at $15/agent/month for the Small plan).
  * **Source URL:** `https://support.liveagent.com/567924-Documentation?r=1`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"consider registering a new free trial account for testing purposes, before using api with your live account."`
  * **Source URL:** `https://www.liveagent.com/`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"LiveAgent comes with a 30‑day free trial that requires no credit card, letting you test all features before committing to a paid plan. How much does LiveAgent cost? LiveAgent pricing starts at $15 per agent/month (billed annually)"`
* **How to get credentials:** An administrator can generate an API key directly from the agent panel.
  * **Source URL:** `https://support.liveagent.com/741982-API-key`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"while logged in as an admin navigate to configuration> system> api which loads the api v3 section where you find existing api keys or add a new one."`

### 4. API Style & Technical Details
* **API Style:** REST API.
  * **Source URL:** `https://support.liveagent.com/741982-API-key`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"home > technical support > liveagent api > rest api > api key"`
* **Breadth:** Broad coverage across core helpdesk objects including agents, tickets, conversations, companies, departments, and knowledge base articles.
  * **Source URL:** `https://support.liveagent.com/567924-Documentation?r=1`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"choose the object (agents, tickets, .) & method (get, post, delete)"`
* **OpenAPI Spec:** LiveAgent provides a Swagger descriptor for its API v3.
  * **Source URL:** `https://support.liveagent.com/567924-Documentation?r=1`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"swagger api descriptor"`
* **Webhooks:** LiveAgent does not feature a traditional dedicated webhooks management portal. Instead, real-time event forwarding is handled natively via automation rules configured with an "HTTP request" action.
  * **Source URL:** `https://www.liveagent.com/`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"In LiveAgent, you can create a webhook to receive notifications on your channel by either building a custom integration using the API or by setting up an automation rule with the "HTTP request" action."`
* **Sandbox:** No permanent free developer sandbox is available; developers are directed to use a free trial account for testing.
  * **Source URL:** `https://support.liveagent.com/567924-Documentation?r=1`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"consider registering a new free trial account for testing purposes, before using api with your live account."`

### 5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers
* **MCP Type:** `official`
* **Details:** LiveAgent features a built-in, native MCP server that allows external AI tools to connect directly to an account to read ticket data and perform actions within the agent's permission scope.
  * **Source URL:** `https://support.liveagent.com/647358-MCP-Integration-for-Agents`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"liveagent exposes a built-in mcp server (model context protocol) that lets you connect external ai tools — such as claude desktop, cursor, claude.ai, flowhunt , or any other mcp-compatible client — directly to your liveagent account."`
* **MCP Authentication:** Supports both profile-generated bearer tokens and an OAuth 2.1 authorization flow with a consent screen.
  - **Source URL:** `https://support.liveagent.com/647358-MCP-Integration-for-Agents`
  - **Verbatim Quote:** `"There are two ways to authenticate your MCP client: - Bearer token — generate an MCP access token in your profile"`
  - **Source URL:** `https://www.liveagent.com/`
  - **Verbatim Quote:** `"Connecting an AI client isn't a one-click, all-access step. It runs through an OAuth 2.1 authorization flow with a consent screen, so you approve exactly which account it acts as."`

### 6. Buildability Verdict
* **Verdict:** `ready_with_friction`
* **Main Blocker:** `paid_plan` / `trial_expiry`
* **Explanation:** A developer can immediately build an integration using the 30-day free trial account (`self_serve_trial`). However, long-term maintenance or production multi-tenant use introduces friction because there is no permanent free developer tier or sandbox, meaning a paid plan is required after trial expiration. Furthermore, the lack of a public OAuth2 application framework forces a per-customer manual setup where each user must generate and copy an `api_key` into the integration platform.
